doubts.claim_under_doubt: The profile tier only adds folders for existing vite-hono projects
doubts.disproof_attempt: The profile tier replaces the defaults, so a vite-hono project with a top-level tests/ would lose those links locally while the gate (which adds the defaults) keeps them.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: FIXED: tests and integration-tests added to the vite-hono list; regression test test_a_vite_hono_project_keeps_the_links_of_its_top_level_tests_folder.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: An unreachable shared dir degrades with one line
doubts.disproof_attempt: It degrades silently because without profile_consumer the profile name cannot be read, so it is indistinguishable from no profile.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: REBUTTED: a warning would fire on every project without a profile; an unreachable shared dir is a broken install and breaks _lib_loader first. Wording corrected (no line is claimed).

doubts.claim_under_doubt: vitest per-package JUnit paths match nested manifest paths
doubts.disproof_attempt: Package-relative file attributes may not re-anchor to server/ or client/ (hypothesis, not traced). Fails red, not green.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: DISCLOSED as a known limit / follow-up: same class as the Playwright rootDir fix of #969, outside this change.

summary: One medium doubt fixed, two low doubts rebutted or disclosed. No path to a false-green gate found.
